capture_boundary: after conditional slope estimation, average-ranking, and final score construction; before score-span checks, selection, capture-separation gates, equal sizing, caps, or organizer risk
input_contract: exact built-in dict[str,float] with sorted nonempty string keys, finite built-in float values, and scores in [-1,1]
return_contract: same key set with finite built-in float values in [-1,1]; malformed return fails flat
raw_beta_use_after_boundary: Only the fixed median upside/downside capture-separation gate for sleeves selected by A5-returned scores.
empty_capture_rule: A scheduled fail-closed state calls A5 once with an empty dict; an off-schedule boundary returns None without a capture.
